verdict.rationale: Cake's only documented programmatic surface is an official MCP connector for Claude, Codex, Cursor and other MCP clients. It answers questions about shareholders, vesting, option pools, SAFEs and notes, but is explicitly 'All read-only'. That falls far short of UI parity: the UI also issues shares, runs splits, conversions and buy-backs, manages certificates, and handles e-signing and raises, and none of these are reachable programmatically. No public REST API or OpenAPI spec was found (all OpenAPI probe paths returned 404). Missing for 10: any write or mutation capability via API, a documented public REST/GraphQL API, an OpenAPI spec, and parity coverage of UI workflows such as issuances, transactions, certificates and signing.
